tasks.label: Extract evidence
tasks.description: A complete table of relevant commitments and risk information.

options.label: Targets, dates and baselines
options.effect: Include structured target variants; unknown baselines remain empty.

options.label: Hazards, vulnerability and exposure
options.effect: Include linked risk-context records, not only commitments.

options.label: Responsible institutions
options.effect: Include source-stated actor roles and unassigned responsibilities.

options.label: Finance and support needs
options.effect: Include costs, financing conditions and stated capacity/technology needs.

options.label: Indicators and monitoring
options.effect: Include source-stated indicators, data sources and reporting arrangements.

tasks.requirements: One or more documents. Multiple documents are processed together with country/source attribution preserved.

tasks.label: Compare policies
tasks.description: Compare selected themes across countries, policy editions or document groups.

options.label: Targets and conditions
options.effect: Compare only compatible baselines/units/scenarios; explain exclusions.

options.label: Risk and DRR coverage
options.effect: Compare documented hazard, vulnerability and risk-function coverage.

options.label: Finance and support
options.effect: Compare stated resources, conditions and support needs without invented funding gaps.

options.label: Monitoring provisions
options.effect: Compare indicators and reporting arrangements; missing means not found in selected sources.

tasks.requirements: Two or more distinct policy editions in comparable groups.

tasks.label: Check implementation information
tasks.description: Identify stated needs and missing implementation information.

options.label: Missing lead or responsibility
options.effect: Flag commitments without a source-stated lead in the chosen scope.

options.label: Finance and capacity needs
options.effect: Separate explicitly stated needs from missing budget/finance information.

options.label: Missing indicator or baseline
options.effect: Flag absent measurement information; do not infer implementation failure.

options.label: Missing deadline or milestone
options.effect: Flag absent timeframes while retaining qualitative commitments.

tasks.requirements: One or more documents. Multiple documents are processed together with country/source attribution preserved.

tasks.label: Prepare a brief
tasks.description: A short answer to a policy question, with an evidence annex.

options.label: Key commitments and deadlines
options.effect: Include a cited commitments section retaining conditions.

options.label: Risk and resilience context
options.effect: Include documented hazard, vulnerability and resilience context.

options.label: Delivery constraints and support
options.effect: Include source-stated constraints, institutions and support needs.

options.label: Questions for follow-up
options.effect: Add analyst-drafted questions grounded in gaps, visibly separate from policy statements.

tasks.requirements: One or more documents. Multiple documents are processed together with country/source attribution preserved.

tasks.label: Translate documents
tasks.description: Save a complete English reading copy with aligned original text for every document.
tasks.requirements: One or more documents. Full text is retained; this task does not summarize or extract policy evidence.

comparison_modes.label: Documents
comparison_modes.help: One column per selected document. Use this for two or more documents from one or several countries. Verified translations of one edition are not independent policies.

comparison_modes.label: Countries
comparison_modes.help: One column per country, combining its selected documents. Requires at least two countries.

comparison_modes.label: Earlier and later editions
comparison_modes.help: Exactly two edition groups from one country and instrument. Assign older and newer documents; edition order is checked before execution.

comparison_modes.label: NDC and NAP
comparison_modes.help: Two groups from one country: at least one NDC and one NAP. Tests policy coherence rather than national performance.

comparison_modes.label: Custom groups
comparison_modes.help: Two or more named document groups. Assign every selected document exactly once.

filter_rule: AND across sector, topic, hazard and risk and resilience function; OR within a dimension. Apply the same thematic scope to every comparison group. Keep missing-in-scope cells visible.

topics.name: Climate planning and governance
topics.definition: Strategies, plans, laws, institutional coordination and mainstreaming.
topics.routing_rule: A finance mechanism also needs CLM-02; do not tag all climate text here.

topics.name: Climate finance and support
topics.definition: Funding mechanisms, investment planning, budget integration, insurance and international support.
topics.routing_rule: A funding source alone does not establish conditionality.

topics.name: Climate information and risk assessment
topics.definition: Observations, scenarios, vulnerability assessments, risk maps and climate services.
topics.routing_rule: Use CLM-04 for operational warnings and preparedness.

topics.name: Early warning and disaster preparedness
topics.definition: Warnings, emergency planning, evacuation, civil protection and disaster readiness.
topics.routing_rule: Do not infer operational warning capacity from a risk study.

topics.name: Climate monitoring and reporting
topics.definition: GHG inventories, transparency, adaptation indicators, evaluation and reporting.
topics.routing_rule: An expected monitoring indicator is not evidence of a result.

topics.name: Economy-wide emissions targets
topics.definition: National emissions ceilings, reduction pledges, net-zero and economy-wide intensity targets.
topics.routing_rule: Sectoral targets use the relevant sector topic; keep EU-wide scope explicit.

topics.name: Land carbon and removals
topics.definition: Sequestration, land-use emissions/removals, forest carbon and LULUCF accounting.
topics.routing_rule: Carbon-sink wording alone does not establish biodiversity benefits.

topics.name: Renewable electricity
topics.definition: Solar, wind, hydropower and other renewable electricity, including distributed generation.
topics.routing_rule: Rooftop PV alone does not imply an Urban label.

topics.name: Grids and energy storage
topics.definition: Transmission, distribution, interconnection, flexibility, storage and network resilience.
topics.routing_rule: A generating plant without grid measures belongs to ENE-01 or ENE-05.

topics.name: Clean heating and fuels
topics.definition: District heating, heat pumps, renewable heat and lower-emission fuel switching.
topics.routing_rule: Vehicle fuel measures use TRN-01; building retrofit packages may also use URB-01.

topics.name: Energy efficiency and demand management
topics.definition: Energy audits, performance standards, efficient equipment and demand management.
topics.routing_rule: Prefer a more specific building, industrial or transport topic when applicable.

topics.name: Fossil energy transition
topics.definition: Coal/oil/gas transition, fossil asset retirement, subsidy reform and supply changes.
topics.routing_rule: Do not infer transition success from a plan or fuel switch.

topics.name: Oil and gas methane
topics.definition: Fugitive emissions, leaks, venting and flaring across oil/gas supply.
topics.routing_rule: Landfill methane uses WST-02; agricultural methane uses AGR-03.

topics.name: Irrigation efficiency
topics.definition: Agricultural water delivery, irrigation modernization and water-saving technologies.
topics.routing_rule: Municipal water supply uses WAT-01; solar irrigation may also use ENE-01.

topics.name: Resilient crops and soils
topics.definition: Crop varieties, soil health, erosion control, land management and resilient farming.
topics.routing_rule: Forest management uses BIO-01; record explicit carbon accounting under CLM-07.

topics.name: Livestock and manure
topics.definition: Animal health/resilience, feed, manure and agricultural methane/nitrous oxide measures.
topics.routing_rule: Human health uses HEA topics.

topics.name: Food systems and farm livelihoods
topics.definition: Food security, agricultural advice, storage, value chains and farm livelihoods.
topics.routing_rule: Food-waste disposal can also use WST-01 when a distinct measure is stated.

topics.name: Water supply and groundwater
topics.definition: Water availability, abstraction, groundwater, drinking water, storage and network losses.
topics.routing_rule: Farm irrigation uses AGR-01; sanitation uses WST-03.

topics.name: River basins and drought management
topics.definition: Basin management, allocation, drought planning, environmental flows and shared waters.
topics.routing_rule: Flood defenses use WAT-03; warnings may also use CLM-04.

topics.name: Flood and coastal protection
topics.definition: River/coastal flood risk, defenses, erosion and sea-level adaptation.
topics.routing_rule: General settlement planning may additionally use URB-02.

topics.name: Water quality and reuse
topics.definition: Surface-water quality, pollution prevention, safe reuse and receiving-water protection.
topics.routing_rule: Wastewater treatment systems use WST-03; keep both if both purposes are explicit.

topics.name: Forest health and management
topics.definition: Forest condition, sustainable management, wildfire/pest control and forest resilience.
topics.routing_rule: Carbon-only forest targets use CLM-07 without an inferred biodiversity claim.

topics.name: Species, habitats and protected areas
topics.definition: Species conservation, habitats, connectivity and terrestrial/aquatic protected areas.
topics.routing_rule: Active ecosystem restoration uses BIO-03.

topics.name: Ecosystem restoration
topics.definition: Restoration of forests, wetlands, peatlands and ecosystems, including ecosystem adaptation.
topics.routing_rule: Record carbon or adaptation co-benefits only with evidence.

topics.name: Heat and human health
topics.definition: Heat-health plans, cooling access, exposure and vulnerable-group protection.
topics.routing_rule: Urban greening uses URB-03 when the physical intervention is stated.

topics.name: Climate-sensitive disease and exposure
topics.definition: Infectious disease, water/vector-borne illness, air-quality exposure and surveillance.
topics.routing_rule: Do not assume health outcomes from emissions reductions alone.

topics.name: Resilient health services
topics.definition: Health facilities, service delivery, emergency capacity, staffing and essential supplies.
topics.routing_rule: General civil protection uses CLM-04.

topics.name: Building energy performance
topics.definition: Building insulation, retrofits, performance codes, passive design and energy-saving systems.
topics.routing_rule: Urban is a taxonomy domain here, not proof of urban geographic scope.

topics.name: Resilient settlements and infrastructure
topics.definition: Spatial planning, building safety, urban drainage and local infrastructure resilience.
topics.routing_rule: Sector-specific transport or energy networks use their specific topics.

topics.name: Urban cooling and green spaces
topics.definition: Trees, green/blue spaces, shading and cooling-oriented public-space design.
topics.routing_rule: General forest restoration uses BIO-03; health links require explicit evidence.

topics.name: Materials, recycling and circularity
topics.definition: Prevention, separate collection, recycling, composting, food waste and circular material use.
topics.routing_rule: Landfill gas uses WST-02; industrial production measures may use IND-01.

topics.name: Solid-waste disposal and methane
topics.definition: Landfill management/emissions, gas capture and disposal-facility resilience.
topics.routing_rule: Oil/gas methane uses ENE-06.

topics.name: Wastewater and sanitation
topics.definition: Sewage, wastewater treatment, sanitation, sludge and associated emissions/resilience.
topics.routing_rule: Receiving-water quality/reuse measures may also use WAT-04.

topics.name: Low-emission vehicles and fuels
topics.definition: Electrification, charging, cleaner transport fuels and vehicle standards.
topics.routing_rule: Public transport service improvements use TRN-02 where relevant.

topics.name: Public, active and shared mobility
topics.definition: Public transport, rail shift, walking, cycling and reduced private-car dependence.
topics.routing_rule: Transport hazard resilience uses TRN-03.

topics.name: Resilient transport networks
topics.definition: Protection/adaptation of roads, railways, ports, airports and logistics.
topics.routing_rule: Emissions measures use TRN-01 or TRN-02.

topics.name: Cleaner production and industrial efficiency
topics.definition: Industrial energy/material efficiency, production technology, modernization and factory resilience.
topics.routing_rule: Process gases/refrigerants use IND-02.

topics.name: Process emissions and refrigerants
topics.definition: Industrial process emissions, cement/chemicals, fluorinated gases and refrigerants.
topics.routing_rule: Generic factory energy efficiency uses IND-01.

topics.name: Tourism adaptation and destination resilience
topics.definition: Destination risks, changing seasons, diversification and resilient visitor infrastructure.
topics.routing_rule: Only use Tourism when the sector is explicit.

topics.name: Tourism resource efficiency
topics.definition: Tourism-specific water, energy, waste and sustainable visitor/accommodation measures.
topics.routing_rule: Keep sector topics too where the source explicitly describes the intervention.

topics.name: Disaster risk and management
topics.definition: Cross-sector all-hazards risk context, disaster governance, emergency response, relief and recovery arrangements.
topics.routing_rule: Use for substantive cross-sector disaster material without a fitting narrower topic. Prefer CLM-04 for warning/readiness and sector topics for sector measures. Select specific risk functions separately; do not add this topic to every hazard mention or infer climate causation.

hazards.label: Flood
hazards.definition: Water inundating land that is normally dry.

hazards.label: Drought
hazards.definition: A sustained precipitation or water deficit affecting systems or people.

hazards.label: Extreme heat
hazards.definition: Unusually high temperatures or heat episodes.

hazards.label: Storm
hazards.definition: Damaging wind or storm conditions; preserve the specific storm type in the source text.

hazards.label: Sea level rise
hazards.definition: Rising average sea level affecting coastal systems.

hazards.label: Coastal erosion
hazards.definition: Loss or retreat of coastal land through erosion.

hazards.label: Landslide
hazards.definition: Downslope movement of soil, rock or debris.

hazards.label: Avalanche
hazards.definition: Rapid downslope movement of snow or ice.

hazards.label: Glacial lake outburst
hazards.definition: Sudden release of water from a glacial lake.

hazards.label: Water scarcity
hazards.definition: Insufficient usable water relative to demand; distinguish drivers from drought when stated.

hazards.label: Extreme cold
hazards.definition: Unusually low temperatures or cold episodes.

hazards.label: Disease
hazards.definition: A disease-related threat; preserve pathogen, vector and climate linkage where stated.

hazards.label: Earthquake
hazards.definition: Ground shaking or associated seismic threat; not automatically climate-related.

hazards.label: Tsunami
hazards.definition: Large sea waves generated by displacement; not automatically climate-related.

hazards.label: Compound hazard
hazards.definition: Interacting or concurrent hazards explicitly discussed together.

hazards.label: Other
hazards.definition: A supported hazard outside this compact list; retain the exact source term in unmapped_terms.

risk_functions.label: Risk understanding
risk_functions.definition: Assess hazards, exposure, vulnerability and risk, or develop relevant risk information.

risk_functions.label: Risk prevention and reduction
risk_functions.definition: Avoid new risk or reduce existing exposure, vulnerability or potential harm.

risk_functions.label: Early warning and preparedness
risk_functions.definition: Build warning capability, contingency plans, exercises and readiness to act.

risk_functions.label: Anticipatory action
risk_functions.definition: Act ahead of a predicted event using a forecast, warning or trigger. General readiness alone is insufficient.

risk_functions.label: Emergency response
risk_functions.definition: Protect people and meet urgent needs during or immediately after an event.

risk_functions.label: Recovery and reconstruction
risk_functions.definition: Restore affected livelihoods, infrastructure and services, including rebuilding more safely.

risk_functions.label: Coping and continuity
risk_functions.definition: Maintain essential functions during disruption through buffers, redundancy or backup arrangements.

risk_functions.label: Systemic transformation
risk_functions.definition: Fundamentally change systems or development pathways to address risk; routine improvements alone are insufficient.
